pairs.summary: CREB1 and PAX8 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 7 of 14 profiles analysed (DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; SW480 colorectal adenocarcinoma (primary); SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); ...). Median lift 1.49x, typical spacing ~55 bp between sites. In 6 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
